# ARAX LABS

> ARAX LABS is a Vienna-based deep-tech startup project in the INiTS ScaleUp programme, researching energy-efficient infrastructure. Its current research focus is measuring and analysing the CPU overhead of observability infrastructure — eBPF instrumentation, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana and Jaeger — using the Google Online Boutique workload and Chaos Mesh anomaly injection. The central research question: how much overhead does observability introduce, and can it be reduced without losing useful observability?

## Key facts

- Location: Vienna, Austria
- Programme: INiTS ScaleUp (from December 2025)
- Founder & CTO: Arash Javan Mojarad — MSc Electrical Engineering (Energy Systems); MSc AI & Data Science, FH Technikum Wien (in progress); previously Platform Engineer at TU Wien / Vienna Scientific Cluster (VSC-4/VSC-5); 95+ certifications
- Status: pre-founding (not yet legally registered)
- Research stack: eBPF, Kepler, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, Chaos Mesh, Kubernetes

## Roadmap (not current capabilities)

- Adaptive and energy-aware observability
- Predictive resource management and model-predictive control
- Energy-aware workload placement and scheduling
- Grid-carbon and electricity-market integration (Grid-SaaS for energy utilities)
- Cross-platform orchestration across Kubernetes, Slurm, OpenShift and OpenStack
